title: What Post-Work Pension Models Is
definition: Post-Work Pension Models: pensions for a post-work world.
description:
Post-Work Pension Models is pensions for a post-work world. It sits squarely in Post-Scarcity Economy, the frontier where lifetime accounts science becomes model logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are longevity-scale. Societies that master model hulls early will shape funding practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why lifetime accounts programs worldwide now treat Post-Work Pension Models as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Post-Work Pension Models needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Post-Work Pension Models
title: Real Research Today: Post-Work Pension Models
definition: Today's documented research behind Post-Work Pension Models.
description:
The road to Post-Work Pension Models is already being paved. Elinor Ostrom's Nobel-winning work on governing the commons underpins commons economics. Kenya's GiveDirectly UBI trials and Stockton's SEED program tested basic income at city scale.

The Venus Project and resource-based economy literature model post-money logistics. Together these programs form the lifetime accounts foundation that Post-Work Pension Models will build on — the model logistics results, the funding methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as model logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Post-Work Pension Models
definition: Estimates Post-Work Pension Models readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Post-Work Pension Models components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a model hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Post-Work Pension Models Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Post-Work Pension Models operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Post-Work Pension Models installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 22340 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where lifetime accounts monitoring, model logistics redundancy, or funding maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Post-Work Pension Models Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Post-Work Pension Models: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Post-Work Pension Models — pensions for a post-work world.

Phase 1 — Prove (lifetime accounts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (model logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (funding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (longevity): model hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and society-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
